answer: Prayers & Duties >> Zakat & Charity Question ID: 46796 Country: United Arab Emirates Title: Zakat Question: Alhamdulillah, I have two daughters (10 years and 9 months old). My question is if I purchase two plots and 20 tolas of gold biscuits for marriage expenses of my beloved daughters, will zakah be due on these investments. Answer ID: 46796 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1189/1194/M=10/1434) If you are buying the plot with the intention that you shall sell it and meet the expenses of marriage with it and will keep the plot and the gold biscuit in your possession then you will have to pay the zakah of both the plots and 20 tolas of gold. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
